offering_description.value: Provides in-home pediatric and adult nursing, therapy and personal care services to medically complex patients. Services are delivered by clinicians visiting patients' homes and are largely funded by government health programs.

primary_services.value: pediatric private duty nursing; adult home health nursing; pediatric therapy; personal care services

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients and families receiving in-home care, mainly children with complex medical needs; B2G: state Medicaid programs and government-funded managed care plans paying for care

end_markets.value: healthcare; home health care; pediatric care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: government program and managed care payments for nursing, therapy and personal care visits

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers nursing and therapy services in patients' homes, paid by payers such as Medicaid and managed care plans

geography_served.value: US national: many states across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: pediatric nursing, adult home nursing, pediatric therapy and personal care, all delivered in the home

distribution_channels.value: own locations: regional and local branch offices that staff home care visits; other: referrals from hospitals, physicians and managed care organizations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: home health agencies need state licensure and Medicare/Medicaid certification, with CMS and state health agencies overseeing care and billing, plus HIPAA privacy rules
